summary: WORKSPACE DASHBOARDS (cinatra#2811, per-scope surfaces S5). THREE STORAGE CHANGES, ONE CONCERN. (1) Organization-independent dashboard rows: dashboards.organization_id drops NOT NULL; dashboards_workspace_entity_org_check binds organization_id NULL to entity_type 'workspace' in both directions; dashboards_workspace_entity_shape_check pins a workspace row to the user-owned '__workspace__' entity with no project and no template; the per-entity partial indexes gain org-NULL twins (dashboards_workspace_entity_idx, dashboards_workspace_entity_default_uniq, dashboards_workspace_entity_name_uniq), each partial on organization_id IS NULL so a twin never sees an organization row. (2) Workspace references: the dashboard_entity_links entity_type CHECK admits 'workspace' (replaced only while its definition lacks it), and dashboard_entity_links_workspace_scope_check pins a workspace link to the '__workspace__' scope; the link keeps its NOT NULL organization_id, which for a workspace link is the target dashboard's home organization. (3) The everyone-grant: workspace_read_granted boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT false plus workspace_read_granted_by and workspace_read_granted_at, with dashboard_entity_links_workspace_grant_check requiring the metadata exactly when granted and forbidding the grant on a non-workspace link; grant history lives in audit_events. PRECONDITION: a row already carrying entity_type 'workspace' outside the new shape (only writable around the service) makes the migration refuse loudly with the count and the remedy rather than rewrite data. IDEMPOTENT: DROP NOT NULL, duplicate_object-guarded constraints, IF NOT EXISTS indexes and columns, a guarded CHECK replacement; the same statements are the fresh-install bootstrap half. DESTRUCTIVE by the convention's classifier (new CHECKs and unique indexes over existing tables), guarded by the precondition. DOWN deletes every workspace dashboard and workspace reference, then restores the narrower shape; no organization dashboard or team, organization or project listing is touched. SEQ 0108: 0107 is the max shipped seq and 0106 is claimed by an open change. migrations/** is HIGH-RISK: maintainer approval required.
